summary: You can now track who follows up on each account in the Identity report, and how far they got.

new.title: Track follow-up actions per user
new.text: Each user in the Identity report now has Action, Status, Who and Notes fields. They are kept across report runs and can be filtered, sorted and exported.

new.title: Set follow-up for many users at once
new.text: Tick users, or take everyone a filtered view shows, and set the fields on all of them at once. Fields you leave alone stay unchanged.

new.title: Follow-up is a record only
new.text: Setting the fields needs Admin and is audited. Nothing in Microsoft Entra or Active Directory changes.
